back.target: And you? (informal, dative: and how are you, asked back after Wie geht's dir?)
back.example: I'm doing well, thanks. And you?

note: Learners may answer "Und du?", which you hear in casual speech, or the colloquial "Und selbst?", so the grammar or a later card could explain why "Wie geht's dir?" takes the dative "dir".
